title: 1br Beautiful Scenery & Grand ole Opry!
description:
Nestled in the heart of Music City, this charming resort exudes Southern hospitality. You'll find everything you need to explore Nashville's vibrant music scene, historic landmarks, and lively nightlife. Nashville is the perfect home base for experiencing the best of Nashville. It's conveniently situated near the Country Music Hall of Fame, the lively shops and restaurants of Green Hills, and the Nashville Zoo. After a day of adventure, return to the resort's warm, welcoming atmosphere.

The space
In the heart of Music City, this cozy resort serves up true Southern hospitality. Explore Nashville’s legendary music scene, historic hotspots, and buzzing nightlife. With top attractions like the Country Music Hall of Fame, Green Hills, and the Nashville Zoo nearby, it’s the perfect home base for your Tennessee adventure. After a day out, kick back in comfort and charm.
Welcome to Club Wyndham Nashville - Your 1-Bedroom, 1-Bath Unit Includes:
Perfect for couples or small groups, this well-designed 1-bedroom unit offers a cozy stay with all the essentials you need. Whether you’re here for a weekend getaway or a longer stay, you’ll feel right at home.
Comfortable 504–632 sq ft layout – ideal for a relaxing and efficient stay
 Sleeps up to 4 guests

Great for couples, solo travelers, or small families

Master Bedroom: King-size bed – spacious and inviting

 Living Room: Queen-size sleeper sofa – open room 

 Kitchen & Dining:
• Mini kitchen – includes basic appliances for light cooking and snacks
• Dining area – great for meals, coffee, or catching up on emails

 Extras:
• In-unit washer and dryer – enjoy the convenience of doing laundry at your leisure

 Important Note:
Buildings 10 and 11 do not have elevator access. Guests with mobility concerns may wish to request a lower floor (based on availability).

 Note: Photos may not reflect the exact unit you’ll be staying in. Your suite may vary slightly.
“Varies” reflects resort policy, not ours – the resort reserves the right to adjust bed sizes or layout configurations.
Wyndham requires a full name and address for guest confirmation, with valid photo Id, and must be at least 21 years of age. 

You must message us the full name and physical address as it appears on the photo Id, of the person who will be checking in. Only this person may check the group in. Changes to the guest confirmation name will require a $99 change fee. This policy is Strict and will not be waved.

A valid credit card will be required at check-in. There will be a $250 credit card hold which is released at check-out if there are no outstanding charges.
